project.name: 星际撤离 · HTML 游戏

project.successCriteriaJson: ["单文件离线可玩","独立 SVG/Canvas 图形","3 关卡与计分","策划/美术/开发协作留痕","评审 Channel 技术验收"]
project.planJson: {"deliverables":[{"key":"design","name":"游戏策划案","description":"精简可落地策划案：玩法循环/3关卡/键位/计分胜负/美术方向/数值表","required":true,"channelId":"9ac1919f-c8d3-405f-89bc-c524d309de94","acceptanceCriteria":["artifact.present","text.contains:玩法"]},{"key":"art","name":"美术资源包","description":"单文件内联 SVG/CSS 资源包（≤10KB），覆盖玩家/敌机/Boss/子弹粒子等 ≥4 个 SVG 与配色","required":true,"channelId":"bbfb670a-fc6f-4c4c-bbfc-256a0505074c","dependsOn":["design"],"acceptanceCriteria":["artifact.present","text.contains:<svg"]},{"key":"game","name":"可玩 HTML 游戏","description":"单文件离线可玩 HTML 游戏（8-14KB）：内联 SVG/canvas、3关卡、敌机生成、碰撞、计分、生命、暂停/重开、game over","required":true,"channelId":"89d72e64-3782-43c9-b207-545bdcaa6b55","dependsOn":["design","art"],"acceptanceCriteria":["text.contains:<!DOCTYPE","text.contains:<canvas","min_bytes:8000","text.contains:score"]}],"work_items":[{"key":"w1","deliverableKey":"design","channelId":"9ac1919f-c8d3-405f-89bc-c524d309de94","title":"游戏策划案","resultKey":"main","execBudgetMinutes":20,"dependsOn":[],"brief":"产出精简可落地策划案（1000-1500字）：玩法循环/3关卡/键位/计分胜负/美术方向/数值表；不要调研，完成时 complete_task 全文放 deliverable。"},{"key":"w2","deliverableKey":"art","channelId":"bbfb670a-fc6f-4c4c-bbfc-256a0505074c","title":"美术资源包（内联 SVG/CSS）","dependsOn":["w1"],"resultKey":"main","execBudgetMinutes":25,"contract":{"inputs":[{"workItemKey":"w1"}]},"brief":"按策划案美术方向产出单文件资源包（≤10KB）：玩家/敌机/Boss/子弹粒子 ≥4 个内联 SVG + CSS 配色；不要调研，完成时 complete_task 全文放 deliverable。"},{"key":"w3","deliverableKey":"game","channelId":"89d72e64-3782-43c9-b207-545bdcaa6b55","title":"游戏 HTML 实现","dependsOn":["w1","w2"],"resultKey":"main","execBudgetMinutes":45,"contract":{"inputs":[{"workItemKey":"w1"},{"workItemKey":"w2"}]},"brief":"按策划案+美术包实现单文件可玩 HTML 游戏（8-14KB）：内联 SVG/canvas，3关卡、键鼠操作、敌机生成、碰撞、计分、生命、暂停/重开、game over、粒子/屏幕震动；不要调研，完整源码全文放 complete_task 的 deliverable。"}]}
